question: How can I place an order on this website?
answer: Ordering is simple and requires zero account creation or advance online payments! Browse our provision catalog, pick your preferred pack size and quantity, and click "Add to Cart". On the Your Order page, review your items, fill in your name, contact number and delivery address, and tap "Place Order". Your order is saved with the store instantly — then you can download a PDF copy or tap "Message us on WhatsApp" to confirm it with the owner.

question: What pack sizes and weights are available for each product?
answer: Every single item at Bensi Queen is conveniently available in five standard pack "weights": 100g, 200g, 500g, 750g, and 1kg. You can choose your desired weight from the custom dropdown selector on each product card. If you want to buy different weights of the same product (for example, 500g Toor Dal for regular sambar and 1kg for a family gathering), each weight is added as an independent line item in your cart.

question: How are prices shown on the website?
answer: Every product card and combo shows its catalog price per pack, your cart shows a running subtotal, and your order receipt, PDF and WhatsApp message all carry the same item-wise amounts and order total. You still pay only on delivery via Cash or UPI — the store confirms availability and payment with you on WhatsApp.

question: How does payment work? Do I need to pay online in advance?
answer: Zero advance online prepayment is required! You pay only after receiving and inspecting your fresh grocery package at your doorstep. We accept Cash on Delivery (COD) as well as instant UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, or BHIM) directly to the delivery person or store UPI ID.

question: Which areas do you deliver to in Chennai?
answer: We provide fast neighborhood doorstep delivery across Chitlapakkam, Tambaram Sanatorium, Chromepet, Hasthinapuram, Selaiyur, East Tambaram, Sembakkam, and Medavakkam. Chitlapakkam and Chromepet orders are typically dispatched within 30 to 45 minutes.

question: Can I download or print a PDF summary of my order?
answer: Yes, absolutely! Right after you place your order, the confirmation page offers "Download order copy". It is an itemized, printable PDF containing your unique order reference, date, customer details, and complete list of provisions with exact packs for your household records.

question: What is the quality guarantee on pulses, dals, and spices?
answer: All pulses and lentils at Bensi Queen are 100% naturally dried and unpolished — free from artificial yellow dyes, chalk powders, or chemical gloss wax. Our spice powders (turmeric, red chilli, coriander, and pepper) are stone-milled in small batches from whole, cleaned spices with zero artificial preservatives or synthetic colors.

question: Do you sell nuts, dry fruits, and cooking oils?
answer: Yes! We offer whole crunchy Grade-W240 Cashew Nuts, California Almonds, Sun-dried seeded Black Raisins, and soft Dates (with and without seeds). We also stock cold-pressed sesame / gingelly oil, pure coconut oil, and double-filtered cooking oils.

question: What are your operating hours?
answer: Bensi Queen is open 7 days a week, Monday through Sunday, from 7:00 AM to 9:30 PM. Orders submitted on WhatsApp during operating hours are reviewed immediately for packing and delivery dispatch.

question: Where is your physical grocery store located?
answer: Our retail store is located at No. 3, Jothi Nagar, 5th Street, Sankara Apartment, Chitlapakkam, Chennai - 600064 (near Chitlapakkam Lake & Tambaram Sanatorium). You are welcome to visit our shop in person or order via WhatsApp for doorstep delivery!

question: What pack sizes/weights are available for pulses and spices?
answer: Every item in our store supports five standard pack "weights": 100g, 200g, 500g, 750g, and 1kg. Select your preferred weight directly from the dropdown on each product card.
